title: wmp.flow.complete — Notification
description: Flow reached a terminal state successfully.

credential_metadata.description: OpenID4VCI flows: the OpenID4VCI 1.1 response-level credential_metadata object, relayed verbatim. May carry secrets (org.siros.secret_seed): never log or retain it. Absent on a replayed completion, see credential_metadata_redacted.

credential_metadata_encrypted_response.description: OpenID4VCI flows: true only when credential_metadata came in a JWE-encrypted issuer response.

credential_metadata_redacted.description: Set only on a replayed completion whose credential_metadata was withheld.
